title: Count the Light Stretches
statement:
A hiker recorded the weight of each of `n` stones along a path, in order. A stretch is any block of one or more consecutive stones. Count the stretches whose total weight is strictly less than `S`. Two stretches that cover different positions are different, even when their weights are the same.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `S`. The second line contains `n` positive integers, the weights in order.

## Output
Print the number of stretches with total weight strictly less than `S`. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= S <= 10^15`
